mirrorMoonErrors.reason: The fever-memory returns to the distant summer clouds and an 'utsusemi blue sky,' exploiting a word that can evoke both the cicada's empty shell and the transient living world. mirror moon replaces the entire blue-sky line with physical discarded shells. The sky vanishes, the sequence repeats the preceding shell image, and the passage's layered cicada language is reduced to one literal object.
mirrorMoonErrors.title: The blue sky of utsusemi becomes discarded cicada shells

It notices the threat before you do and reduces your physical activity to the bare minimum so your condition won’t deteriorate any further.”
